user_en: A patient on weekly methotrexate has been prescribed trimethoprim (or co-trimoxazole) for a UTI by another clinician. They ask if it's fine to take both. Advise.

runs.answer:
DECISION: URGENT
SEVERITY: 10
RED FLAGS: none identified
CONDITION: Methotrexate-trimethoprim drug interaction risk leading to potential toxicity
ICD-10: T24.1
ROUTING: Contact prescribing clinician immediately for alternative UTI treatment or methotrexate dose adjustment; do not take both medications concurrently without medical supervision
SAFETY-NET: Monitor for signs of methotrexate toxicity (e.g., severe nausea/vomiting, mouth sores, bruising/bleeding, infection) within 48 hours; seek emergency care if symptoms develop
